comment: Terms for the translations of the interface and agent catalogs. The meanings come from CONTEXT.md and the interface documentation. keep means the term stays in English.

terms.meaning: The product name.
Optical character recognition.
The file format.
Artificial intelligence, as in AI Chat.
The name of the model checks that read each chat turn. It is a name, not a number.
An administrative group of datasets that a group of users can read.
One ingested folder of files inside a collection.
One file, email or archive member that the search finds.
One view of a document, such as extracted text, the original PDF or an OCR PDF.
The page that lists collections, datasets, folders and files.
A full-text query over the readable collections, and the page that shows its results.
A condition that narrows search results, such as file type or date.
A category of passages that need review. It does not establish misconduct.
A person, organization, place or other name that extraction found in a document.
The AI assistant that answers chat messages with search tools.
A conversation with the agent.
An investigation board: a graph of findings that agents explore.
One stored result of a board with its citations.
A question that a finding leaves for the board.
Work that brings stored results of a dataset to what the current code and settings produce.
Files that a person sends to the server into a collection.
A person with permission to manage users, collections and settings.
One recorded pipeline job, such as an ingestion or a processing update.
A record of why a pipeline operation or stage stopped.
A processing failure of one document.
The grid of sheets, columns and cells of a spreadsheet or delimited-text document.
A reference from an answer to a document passage.
The language of the website's own text.
The language that the agent answers in.
The detected language of a document's text, used as a search filter.
The page where a person chooses their languages.
